raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

On Ampere (sm_80/sm_86), 20 fp8 cases of the Qwen4Exp QSA kernel tests fail before they run: Triton refuses to compile a kernel that takes a `torch.float8_e4m3fn` tensor below sm_89. Serving is not affected. Below sm_89 the layer passes an fp8 main KV cache as its `uint8` storage (#60602), and it does not run the fp8 indexer or the fused fp8 prepare. This PR makes the tests do the same. Test-only change.

The failing cases came with #54890 (fp8 indexer cache), #55557 (fp8 main KV cache) and #57097 (fused prepare). #60602 added the Ampere path in the layer but did not update these tests, and NVIDIA CI does not run these files.

## Claims

- `test_qsa_sparse_paged_attention_correctness[*_fp8]`: below sm_89 the kernel now gets the `uint8` view of the fp8 cache, as `Qwen4ExpQSAImpl.forward` passes it, so the Ampere byte-decode path is tested against the same dense reference.
- `test_qsa_decode_selection_correctness` / `test_qsa_prefill_selection_correctness` (fp8 indexer) and `test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[*-indexer_dtype1]` (fused fp8 prepare) are skipped below sm_89, because the layer does not run these paths there (`use_fused_qsa_prepare` requires sm_89+ for an fp8 cache).
- No change on sm_89+: the same cases run with the same tensors.

## Validation

**Setup.** 1 × A100-SXM4-40GB (sm_80), vLLM main 16d667348d, compiled ops and Triton 3.8.0 / torch 2.14.0 from the nightly image `vllm-openai:nightly` (cu130), `pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py`.

**Before (main): 22 failed, 68 passed.** 20 fp8 cases fail at compile time:

```
E   triton.compiler.errors.CompilationError: at 1:0:
    def _qsa_sparse_paged_gqa_splitk_kernel(
    ^
    ValueError("type fp8e4nv not supported in this architecture. The supported fp8 dtypes are ('fp8e4b15', 'fp8e5')")
```

The same error comes from `_qsa_mqa_paged_uniform_kernel` (5), `_qsa_mqa_paged_prefill_kernel` (4), `_qsa_prepare_kernel` (8) and `_qsa_sparse_paged_gqa_splitk_kernel` (3). The other two failures in the same run: one `*_fp8` r2048 case ran out of memory at the fp8 cast (`test_qsa_reference.py:1102`, 1.08 GiB free of 39.49 GiB), and `test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[tiled-indexer_dtype0]` (bf16) failed `assert_close` (`test_qsa_prepare.py:400`). Both pass in the run with this PR; I did not isolate them, so I do not claim them as fixed.

<details>
<summary>Failing cases on main (A100)</summary>

```

FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_decode_selection_correctness[dtype1-4-2]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_decode_selection_correctness[dtype1-4-33]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_prefill_selection_correctness[False-0-dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_prefill_selection_correctness[False-1792-dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_prefill_selection_correctness[True-0-dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_prefill_selection_correctness[True-1792-dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py::test_qsa_sparse_paged_attention_correctness[tp1_r1_fp8]

FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[mrope-indexer_dtype1]

FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[mrope-no-position-cache-indexer_dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[mrope-model-1d-no-position-cache-indexer_dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[text-with-position-cache-indexer_dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[fresh-indexer_dtype1]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[tiled-indexer_dtype0]
FAILED tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py::test_qsa_fused_prepare_matches_unfused[tiled-indexer_dtype1]
```

</details>

**After (this PR): 73 passed, 17 skipped, 0 failed.** The 17 skips are the 9 fp8 indexer selection cases and the 8 fused fp8 prepare cases; the 4 `*_fp8` paged-attention cases now run the uint8 byte-decode path and pass.

```bash
pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_prepare.py
```

Lint: `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean.

## Details

- Triton has no e4m3 (`fp8e4nv`) type below sm_89, so any kernel argument of dtype `torch.float8_e4m3fn` fails to compile there. #60602 added the Ampere path in the layer: `Qwen4ExpQSAImpl.forward` passes the cache's `uint8` storage below sm_89, and `_maybe_dequant` decodes the e4m3 bytes in the kernel (#60992 made this faster). The tests still passed `float8_e4m3fn` on every architecture.
- The fp8 indexer cache has no Ampere path: the indexer kernels take `float8_e4m3fn` tensors. These cases are skipped below sm_89, not changed. Rejecting `indexer_kv_dtype="fp8"` below sm_89 at config time would give users a clear error, but that is a behaviour change and out of scope here.
- Scope: test-only, +40 / −5 in two files.
